__doc__: SOT-1520 production incident auto-response config for scripts/ai/incident_response.sh. Keys are a repo slug (owner/name) or a project name (from project_repos.json); the value configures how that deployed service is monitored and rolled back. EMPTY by default = nothing is monitored. The loop stays OFF unless INCIDENT_RESPONSE_ENABLED is truthy, and automatic rollback additionally requires INCIDENT_AUTO_REMEDIATE (otherwise the rollback command is dry-run logged only). Real monitoring/rollback need deploy-environment credentials that do NOT live in this repo — enable it there. Keys starting with __ are ignored.

__fields__.healthUrl: HTTP(S) health endpoint to probe (e.g. https://my-service/healthz).
__fields__.expectStatus: Expected HTTP status for a healthy probe (default 200).
__fields__.maxLatencyMs: Latency above which an otherwise-OK probe is 'degraded' (0 disables).
__fields__.rollbackCmd: Shell command that rolls back / degrades the service (e.g. redeploy previous revision, shift traffic).

__note__: toddler-private-rag entry below is wired to the real deployed Cloud Run backend (health endpoint verified 200). The loop is still OFF until INCIDENT_RESPONSE_ENABLED=1, and rollbackCmd is only executed when INCIDENT_AUTO_REMEDIATE=1. rollbackCmd calls scripts/ai/gcp_rollback_cloudrun.sh which resolves the real previous READY revision (Cloud Run has no 'PREVIOUS' traffic keyword) and shifts 100% traffic to it. For service-side (no-local-host) monitoring see scripts/ai/incident_response_gcp_setup.sh and docs/incident-response.md.
